religion_basis: survey estimate: structural survey, permanent resident population 15+
religion_note: BFS structural survey (Strukturerhebung) 2022-2024: religious affiliation of the permanent resident population aged 15 and over, weighted by BFS; the shares are of the average of the 3 annual weighted estimates, which narrows the sampling error of a single year (whose confidence intervals, for the small groups of the small cantons, run past ±50%). A group BFS suppresses in any of the years for too few respondents is left out, so the shares can fall short of 100. The census has not asked every resident since 2000. Sample: BFS drew about 114,525 people in Vaud over 2022-2024 (its population considered times its sampling rate, from BFS's stratification tables cc-t-40-se_strata).
